literal: Painful is being begged, until of those who begged the sweet face is seen.
translation: Being asked for charity is painful only until you see the sweet, relieved face of the person who asked.
modern: தன்னிடம் வந்து யாசித்தவரின் மகிழ்ச்சியான முகத்தைக் காணும் வரைக்கும், ஒருவரால் யாசிக்கப்படுவது துன்பமானதே ஆகும்.
explanation: This couplet captures the emotional journey of giving. Initially, being approached by someone in need causes distress, as it highlights their suffering and places a burden on the giver. However, this pain lasts only until the giver provides what is needed. Once the giver sees the sweet, relieved face of the receiver, the initial distress transforms into joy.
